title: 3D Quality Check
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776264545305)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271079833)Editor #### Compatibility: Supported for 3D files. Find the detailed file format list here. # # **Updates** 3D Quality Check allows you to check the properties of the CLO file in CLO-SET. [Legacy Content Page] * 3D Quality Check Status in the Version Information on the Left Pane * Detailed Information on the 3D Quality Check Tab ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776274210073)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271643417) | [New Content Page] * 3D Quality Check Status in the Overview Tab * Detailed Information on the 3D Quality Check Tab ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57437118376857)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57437118381337) ---|--- 1. What it Quality Check? 2. Setup Quality Check 3. Quality Check in Content Page 4. Quality Check Results 5. Supported File Formats 6. Setup Guide PDF (ENG) # **Details** ### 1) What is 3D Quality Check? * CLO-SET Quality check allows teams to automize the QC process of the CLO files. CLO-SET will automatically check the uploaded CLO file properties per the standards setup by the Admin and mark the result for the team to view. * Quality Check standards can be set for each Company within the Group. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56797432759065) ### 2) Setup Quality Check **Permission** : ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873) Group Admin, Company Admin * To start using the feature, your Company must have a 3D Quality Check standards setup by the Admin. This can be done on the [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/articles/45303214894873) page. * In Company Settings, click Content > 3D Quality Check. Then, click the activate toggle. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776272087961) * For more details on how to input the properties and what each property refers to in CLO, please[ download the PDF guideline.](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49715354278809) [![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776275644441)](https://support.clo-set.com/guide-media/01JR7CPDFB3DKX4HT02CFREMYD) | [![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776283678233)](https://support.clo-set.com/guide-media/01JR7CPDFB3DKX4HT02CFREMYD) ---|--- * **Please note** : updating the properties will NOT be synced to older tests. You must re-upload the file to apply the new standards. ### 3) Quality Check in Content Page Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776264545305)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271079833)Editor [Legacy Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776274210073)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776324372377)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271643417) | [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56797423081369)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56797432757913) ---|--- * Once the Quality Check is activated and setup, it will be applied to the newly uploaded files. * Click the red 'QC' icon to view the full test result. * **Please Note** : Quality Check runs only once for all versions. Re-upload the file to run the quality check again. * The 'QC' label will be displayed on the latest version uploaded. To review the QC for older versions, click the ••• menu and select '3D Quality Check' option as displayed below. ### ### 4) Quality Check Results Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776264545305)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271079833)Editor * A new tab will open with the full test result. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56797423094297) 1. Category of the property 2. Property setup in Company Settings 3. Criteria setup in Company Settings 4. Test result: Passed 5. Test result: Failed, click the list icon for the list of materials that failed the test 6. Test result: N/A. Property not included in the checklist 7. Select to only view the properties that failed the test * **Please note** : Updating or editing the 3D file should be done in CLO. Also, Quality Check runs only once for all versions. Re-upload the file to run the quality check again. * **QC Bot** : Simplifies complex quality check results into a clear summary in the comment section of the Content Page. When the **3D Quality Check** feature is enabled, users can run the QC Bot by clicking the button. The QC Bot reviews the file and provides a summarized analysis of multiple quality check criteria in the _comment section_. This helps users quickly understand potential issues such as: Incorrect settings, possible production risks. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57392106162201)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57392121451545) ### 5) Supported File Formats * Compatible with all file types supported in 3D Viewer, as of Dec 2024. * More specifically, 3D Quality Check is compatible with the file extensions listed below: * zpac, zprj, avt, obj, fbx, dae, glb, grp, zfab, zmod, trm, btn, bth, zpl, zsd, zse, zsp, zpu, zsl, zst, zss, sst, zacs, pos, hpos
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide a comprehensive guide on the 3D Quality Check feature in CLO-SET, detailing permissions, setup, results, and supported file formats to enhance the quality assurance process for CLO files.

title: CLO-SET Thumbnail
content:
#### Content: Applicable to Content uploaded or updated on March 12th, 2024 and onward, or PDF files uploaded on July 9th, 2024 and onward. # **Objective** Understand the Thumbnail types and rules in CLO-SET. 1. Default Colorway 2. Custom View 3. Thumbnail Types & Rules 4. Thumbnail Change 5. PDF Thumbnail # **Details** CLO-SET offers two different thumbnail options of content. When uploading 3D files to CLO-SET, users can select either the "**Default Colorway"** or the **"Custom View"** option. ### ### **1) Default Colorway** **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778235562649)** * CLO-SET Thumbnails are created based on the original file. Starting Mar 2024, CLO-SET thumbnails will be synced with the Default Colorway in CLO3D. * '**Deafult Colorway** ' is the selected Colorway at the time of saving the file in CLO3D. * To change the 'Deafult Colorway' used in CLO-SET, you may upload a new Version or 'Create New Version' ### **2) Custom View** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47592686255641) * Custom View is a function in CLO3D that allows you to save a certain Viewpoint. CLO-SET, supports thumbnail images and turntable images based on the Custom View. Link to set [Custom View](https://clo3d.zendesk.com/knowledge/editor/01JWB42WYFJTD6VSN6JS0ECPJP/en-us?brand_id=44407677825689&section_id=44750293195417) in CLO-SET. > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is available only for .**zprj files** as the Custom View data is only
> > saved for **.zprj file** > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is applied to anywhere utilizing thumbnail features, including
> > **Linesheet** , **Visual Board** , **Web Tech Pack** and any other thumbnails in CLO-SET. ### **3) Thumbnail Types & Rules** * ### Content Page There are 3 types of Thumbnail images on the Content Page. **[Important]** All Thumbnails within the Content Page will be based on the Default Colorway of the uploaded file. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778259295897) * ### Workroom View **[Important]** Beginning March 2024, Workroom Thumbnail and Turntable will be based on the Default Colorway of the original file. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778250198553) ![thumbnail3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778286596121) * ### Assortment Assortment Thumbnail is shown based on the Default Colorway of latest version at the time Content was moved to the Assortment. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778286769689) ### 3) Thumbnail Changes * ### Change Thumbnail * Thumbnail in Content Information tab * Thumbnail in Workroom view * Turntable will NOT be updated [New Content Page] You can change the thumbnail image shown in the Workroom in two ways in the new content page: * In the Overview tab, click the camera button below the thumbnail to upload an image from your local drive. * In the Viewer tab, click the Settings button at the bottom right → Change Thumbnail to set the current viewer screen as the thumbnail image. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57710465618073)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57710465619865) [Legacy Content Page] You can change the thumbnail image shown in the Workroom in two ways in the legacy content page: * Click the **Change Thumbnail** button at the bottom right of the Content Page to set the current viewer screen as the thumbnail image. * In the left pane under the **More Information** tab, click the camera button below the image to upload a thumbnail image from your local drive. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778287073433) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778251183641) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778287393561) * ### Version Update * Uploading a new [Version](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) will auto-update the Thumbnails in Content Page and Workroom. * To avoid the changes in Thumbnail, please activate 'Keep the current Thumbnail' option. ![Group 134.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47592686257817) * ### Create New Version * Creating a New Version will update all Thumbnails in Content Page & Workroom View. * Selected Colorway at the time of creating the new Version will replace the 'Default Colorway' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778272699801). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778294849945) * ### Delete Latest Version * * Deleting the Latest Version will NOT update the Thumbnails shown in Workroom or Content Page - Information tab. Thumbnail from the deleted version will be displayed. To change the Thumbnail, please upload a new Version or Create New Version. ### 4) PDF Thumbnail * When uploading a PDF file as a new Content or Version, CLO-SET will create a thumbnail based on the cover page of the uploaded PDF file. * Users can click the 'PDF preview' button on the viewer to load the preview of the full document. * If the 'keep current thumbnail' option is enabled, Thumbnail will not be updated on Content Info tab and Workroom page. * If the file is too large or cannot be opened due to error, a PDF icon will be displayed instead. * * Content Page Thumbnail (PDF) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778273168537) * * Workroom Thumbnail (PDF) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778295266329) > 💡 **Note:** Thumbnails on the Content Page can now be viewed in full screen. By clicking the **expand icon** located beneath the thumbnail, a new window will open, allowing to view a larger, clearer version of the image. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52576376979097) ### **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52576376984473)** ###
content_description: This web page aims to provide a comprehensive guide to understanding the various thumbnail types and rules in CLO-SET, effective from March 12, 2024, and July 9, 2024, for new content updates and PDF uploads.

title: Image Viewer
content: ## **Objective** * What is Image Viewer? * Company Settings ## **Details** ### 1) What is Image Viewer? * Image Viewer is a front view of your 3D Content in a static 2D image format. You can zoom in/out but can not rotate the garment as done in 3D viewer. * Image viewer allows for a faster workflow when all you need is to review the front image and share feedback. You may also leave annotation on the Image Viewer mode to share with your teammates, even before the 3D content is loaded. [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56807968550553) [Legacy Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778513623577) *The image will initially load as 512*512 size, and will convert to higher quality (1024*1024). Please allow a short period of time for higher quality image to load. ### 2) Enable Image Viewer in Company Settings Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778513902489) Group Admin, Company Admin * To enable the Image Viewer option for your Company, go to [Company Setting](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/articles/45303214894873-Company-Setting) * Turn on the '**CONTENT_IMAGE VIEWER** ' option to start using 2D viewer ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778514200089) | | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778514491033) ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778529731737)
content_description: Discover how to utilize the Image Viewer for efficient 2D previews of your 3D content, enabling quick feedback and collaboration within your team.

title: Annotation
content:
# **Objective** Create an Annotation for a detailed feedback. 1. Create/Edit Annotation 2. Annotation Shortcut 3. Download Annotations in PDF 4. Send Annotation by email 5. Copy Annotation to new Version # **Details** ### 1) Create Annotation * From your Dashboard, click the Content to open the Content page, where you can view the 3D Viewer. _Or, you can upload 3D files (zprj, zpac) or other image files (jpg, png, etc.) to create the annotation on._ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57497519090201) * In the **Content page** , click **Annotation**. * ▶ Create [Annotation](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191080217) > _**Annotation on the Content Page**_
> > * In **New** **Content** Page > > Create an Annotation and Set the Viewpoint : Click the **Annotation** button at the top right of the **Viewer** tab. Before creating an annotation, set your desired viewpoint in the Viewer.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56806565540249)
> > Leave Annotations with. the Drawing & Editing Tools : Utilize the features in the toolbar to add annotations. **Text** and **Pen tools** are supported to provide a more advanced editing experience.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56806581903385)
> > Save or Add New Marker : Click the **Save** button to complete the annotation, or click **Add New Marker** to continue adding markers while creating annotations.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56806565541145)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56806581900441)
> > View Annotation List : View all annotations for the content. Replies and Nested Replies are visible in the Annotation List. > > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57497498417177)
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page
> > Click on the Annotation icon (![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57497498418713)) at the top right corner of the 3D Viewer or 2D Pattern Viewer
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57497519093529)
> > Add comments, shapes, lines, or images to leave feedback. When finished, click **Complete** in the top-right corner and click the **Annotation icon** to see the full list of annotations in the right pane. > > Click 'Complete' to save the annotation
> > Once saved, click the Annotation icon (![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57497498418713)) on the right pane to view the list of Annotations
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57497498421145)
> > * Annotation Toolbar ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778432888217) | Comment (T) | Click within the 3D viewer, write a comment, and click ‘POST’. Double-click to edit. Shortcuts: **Bold (Ctrl + B)** / _Italic (Ctrl + I)_ /Underline (Ctrl + U) ---|---|--- Image (I) | You can attach an image file as annotation. Select (V) | You can change the position of comment or drawing. Pencil (B) Line (L) Pen (P) Arrow (A) Arc (C) Rentangle (R) | Create drawing and basic figures. Line Color (O) Line Width (W) | You can set drawing color and thickness. ### 2) Annotation Shortcut All Functions | Copy | Ctrl + C ---|---|--- Paste | Ctrl + V Flip Horizontally | Shift + H Flip Vertically | Shift + V ![Annotation.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778417947417) ### 3) Download Annotation in PDF [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56806581904921) Click the Annotation List button on the right, then click the ••• button to download the annotation as a PDF. [Legacy Content Page] ![Screenshot 2023-11-08 at 6.29.00 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778418213785) Click on the Annotation icon on your right pane to view the list of Annotations. Next to each Annotation, you may click on ••• icon to download the PDF. To download a PDF including all Annotations, click on 'PDF' button at the top right corner. ### 4) Send Annotation by email ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54366775647001)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54366812416793) When you click the **Email** button next to the **PDF Download** button, you can send the annotation notification immediately. Please enter the recipient’s email address and click **Send**. The email will include a **content download button** , which will remain valid for **up to two weeks** after the email is sent. > Note : Sending annotations by email is only supported on the legacy Content Page. ### ### 5) Copy Annotation to new Version ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 3.17.05 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778433888921) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 3.17.49 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778434264473) | ![Screenshot 2023-11-08 at 6.36.22 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778419247129) ---|---|--- * From the latest version, click on 'Annotation' button on the right pane * Click ''Get previous version of the Annotation' button * Select the Annotations you'd like to bring to the new Version > Note : Copy Annotation to new Version is only supported on the legacy Content Page.

title: Comment
content:
# **Objective** Share your feedback with the team with CLO-SET Comment feature. 1. Creating Comment * Attach Images in Comment * AI Translator in Comments 2. Search Comment 3. Workroom & Assortment Comment 4. Web Tech Pack Comment 5. Permission 6. Notification # **Details** ### 1) Creating Comment **1\. Create Comment:** click ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778356271257) icon from top-right corner, and start creating comments. You can tag individual user or [Teams](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303212732441) by using @ (ex. @clovirtualfashion). Maximum length is 3000 letters. *Please note that mentioning a non-member will automatically grant can View access. **2\. Create Editor:** You can edit the color, font, background color, or add emojis and attachments on the comment. Supported formats for attachments are: png, jpg, jpeg, pjpeg, gif, bmp. You may attach up to 25 files per Comment. Shortcut keys available on Edit Mode: * **Bold** : Ctrl (Cmd) + B * _Italic_ : Ctrl (Cmd) + I * Underline: Ctrl (Cmd) + U * @Mention: @ + name * Emoji 😊: [Window + . ] OR [Ctrl+Cmd+Space Bar] * In addition, bullet & numbering is also available as below. To add a bullet, add an asterisk (*) and hit space **3\. View All**[**Versions**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961)**:** By default, you will comments on all Versions. Uncheck to only view the comments created on current Version. > _**Comment on the Content Page**_
> > * In **New** **Content** Page : Click the **Comment** icon at the top right of the content page, enter your comment, and click **Post**. (type in comments, and tag teammates with "@" . You must first [invite](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176205081) the teammate for tagging)
> > The Comment feature has been expanded to the content level, allowing comments to be added while reviewing different tabs.
> > An activity log is also available for review. > (_Note: The activity log is only accessible to users with Editor-level permissions or higher._)
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495567360793)
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page : Click the Comment icon (![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57497302042905)) from the right pane and type in comments, and tag teammates with "@" (You must first [invite](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176205081) the teammate for tagging)
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57497302044569)
> > * ### Attach Images to your Comment (updated Feb 2024) 1. Drag & Drop Images from your local drive. 2. Preview Images before posting. 3. Availability to post Images only (without a text). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778347736217) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778347989657) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334192793) ---|---|--- * ### AI Translator in Comments CLO-SET now supports **AI-powered translation** in comments to improve cross-language collaboration. * Available in both **Space Comments** and **Content Comments** * Click **Translate** on a comment to view it in your preferred language This feature helps teams communicate more effectively across regions and languages without leaving the platform. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393488326425) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393488328985) ### 2) Search Comment * Search the comment you're looking for. Type in the keyword, and hit enter to view the results at the bottom. ![Screenshot 2023-11-08 at 5.55.22 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334395033) ### 3) Workroom & Assortment Comment * Commenting is also available at the [Workroom](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) and [Assortment](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168765593) level. * Please see below for details on Permissions (create, edit, and delete) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334541081) ### 4) Web Tech Pack Comment * Commenting is also available on all [Web Tech Pack](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) tabs. * Comments are created/saved separate on each Tab (Overview, BOM, Construction, Measurement, and Cost Estimation). * Under each Comment, you can find the version information of the uploaded file. * Please see below for details on Permissions (create, edit, and delete) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334743065) > Note : Web Tech Pack and Web Tech Pack comments are only available in the legacy Content Page. > In the New Content Page, a unified comment feature is provided at a higher level, allowing you to leave comments across all tabs, including BOM, POM, and Cost Estimation. ### 5) Permission **Space** | **Action** | **Admin & Collaborator** | **Editor** | **Viewer** ---|---|---|---|--- **All** | **Create** | O | O | O **Workroom** **WTP** **Content** | **Edit** | * Group, Company Admin: O * Brand Admin, Collaborator: Limited* | Limited* **Delete** **Assortment** | **Edit** | * Admin: O * Collaborator: Limited* **Delete** **All** | **Mention others** | O | O | X *Can only Edit/Delete comments created by oneself, cannot modify comments created by other users. **Permission varies on Space Level. To start using Comment features, user must have permission to the applicable Space/Content. For example, if a user holds Content Editor permission, they can create new Comment on that Content, but may not be able to create Workroom Content. ### 6) Notification * When a Comment is created/edited/deleted, notification will be sent to the users with permission to the Workroom/Assortment/Content. * To stop receiving notifications, end users can turn off notification settings on specific Space or Content by unchecking the 'bell' button. * Notification of new Comments will be displayed on the Notifications tab. * Email Notification may be sent based on the end user's notification settings on 'My Page'. \- Depending on the notification settings, user can either receive all notifications or only those that are relevant. 1. 1. **All Comments** \- Continue to receive notifications for all comments. 2. **Mentioned Comments and Replies to My Comments Only** \- Receive notifications when mentioned \- Receive notifications when someone replies to the comment writer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334892825) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778370438809) ---|--- > 💡 **Note:** The **"Changes on Comment"** notification options can be configured on the **My Page**. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54775456945689)
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide users with a comprehensive guide to utilizing the CLO-SET Comment feature for effective feedback sharing, including creating, searching, and managing comments across various workspaces and content types.

title: Workflow & Status
content:

Workflow & Status in Line Sheet # **Details** ### 1) Workflow vs. Status **Workflow** | **Status** ---|--- Can create custom names in Company Settings Available to be edited by Admin / Collaborator / Editor Synced with Line Sheet * For each Content * Can be used as a search filter | * For each Colorway within the Content > [New Content Page]

title: Invite/Share
content:
Invite your team members, or share your work to your partners. Understand the difference and learn how to start collaborating. # **Objective** 1. Invite vs. Share 2. Invite 3. Share 4. Accessible People 5. Public Content 6. Permission Management # **Details** ### 1) Invite vs. Share There are 4 Permission Level in CLO-SET. You may either **Invite** your teammates as Admin or Collaborator, or **Share** your work to Editors or Viewers. Learn more on CLO-SET Permission [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). ![PermissionFinal.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776122808857) | * **Invite** Admin or Collaborators * **Share** to Editor or Viewers * Add Group Operator ---|--- ### 2) Invite * ### to Company / Brand ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 3.38.30 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776122924057) Company Admin has the authority to invite specific users to Company. Company and Brand Admin have the authority to invite specific users to Brand. ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 3.40.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776106780569) | 1\. Enter the email address of the user you wish to invite 2\. Select permission (Admin/Collaborator) 3\. Click 'Invite' ---|--- #### ***[Changes on Invite]** **From May 2024** | **Prior to May 2024** ---|--- Recipient is added to the Group and granted access automatically, and do NOT need to accept the invite. | Recipient must first accept the invite to access the Space. ### 3) Share ### Share Workroom / Assortment / Content Editors or above can share Workroom/Assortment/Content with others. * From Workroom/Assortment, use the right pane. * From Content page, click on 'Share' tab on your far right. ### > _**Share with Email on the Content Page**_
> > * In **New** **Content** Page :
> > Users with access to the content can be viewed in the **People with access** section.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57496551714841)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57496536026777)
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57496551715737)
> > ### **📝** Share with Link Policy update Update (December 2025) The **Enable Download** option has been updated. * **Share with Link remains available** , and **guests can still view content** as before. * **Downloads are limited to group members only**. * Even if **Enable Download** is enabled, **non–group members can view content but cannot download.** ### 4) Accessible People ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 3.56.54 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776092477721) | | • At the bottom of the Share Tab, you may view the full list of Accessible People to each Space/Content. • This includes not only the people shown on the above list, but all users who with access. *For example, from Workroom, you can only invite Editor/Viewers, but anyone with Admin/Collaborator permission on the upper level Spaces can also access the Workroom. ---|---|--- ### 5) Public Content You may publicize your Content to share with a broader audience. There are 2 options: 1\. [Embed](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195817497) the 3D Viewer to your own website \- NO CLO-SET account required to view 2\. Share with Link - Anyone with the link can view -please be cautious as this will make your Workroom/Content Public. That is, anyone with the link can view your Content, and share it with others without a limit. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776140178585) ### 6) Permission Management * for Group Admin / Group Operator To view the full list of Group members and manage Permission, visit 'Permission Management' from the Console tab. Find out more details on Permission Management [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195393049). ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 5.29.18 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776107853849)

title: Linked Contents (Parent-Child Contents)
content: #### Permission: ALL (applicable to all Contents you have download/upload access to) # **Objective** With this update, you can now link the Contents when uploading new files from CLO. Create the Parent-Child relationship between old and new seasons OR between block files and final output to better track and manage your assets. ![linkfromclo.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778390531097) 1. [How To](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/8737455380879#h_01HKC8NSJMKEA2BNCCV3VY44BB) 2. [Requirements](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/8737455380879#h_01HKCA5BCE4VDBKJYE1WMK8F9T) # **Details** ### 1) How To To use this feature, you must first setup CLO-SET Library in CLO 3D. Find instructions [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191662617). * First, download a file from your CLO-SET Library in CLO. When setting up the Link between Contents, this original file will work as the**'Parent Content'** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778375604121) * Make design edits in CLO3D (ex. create a new Colorway or change fabric/material used) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391024153) * Once the design edit is complete, upload it as a new Content with 'Upload to CLO-SET' option. You can also select Render/Tech Pack via CLO-SET. * Please note that 'Linked Contents' feature is not compatible when uploading a new Version. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391314329) * Turn on the 'Linked Content' option to create the Parent-Child relationship. 1. Select the Group to upload the new Content. Please note that Contents in different Groups can not be 'Linked' as a Parent-Child. 2. Turn on 'Linked Content' button. 3. Select the Workroom to upload the new Content. Selecting an existing Content is disabled when the 'Linked Content' option is on. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391631769) * Once uploaded, you can click on 'Linked Contents' to view the Parent/Child Contents. in Content Page | From **'Child Content'** | From **'Parent Content'** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391794841) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778376539673) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778376740505) * In the New Content Page, you can view linked content information at the bottom of the Overview tab. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57478037915033) ### 2) Requirements 1\. Rules for identifying 'Original Content' * The 'Original Content' is always the **first file** you open in CLO3D. * If you used multiple files from CLO-SET Library to create the new Content, only the very first file added would be linked as the Original Content. * If you started with a non-CLO-SET file and added files from CLO-SET library, the latter would **not** be linked as the Original Content. 2\. Rules for Parent-Child relationship * Both of the Parent & Child Contents **MUST** be in the same CLO-SET Group to utilize the 'Linked Content' feature.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to establish Parent-Child relationships between files in CLO-SET, enabling efficient asset tracking and management during the upload process.

title: New Configurator
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193164697)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776177016345)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776224902169)Editor # **Objective** Learn how to use the New Configurator in CLO-SET 1. Requirements 2. Configurator UI 3. Color * Color Switch 4. Basic Parameters * Auto-generate Normal Map 5. Reflection 6. Graphic Editor 7. Save/Add Colorway 8. Troubleshooting # # **Details** ### **Learn about the New Configurator from the CLO-SET Team!** ### 1) Requirements Compatibility: Zprj/Zpac files saved on CLO 2024.1.244 or above ### 2) Configurator UI The **New Configurator** is available in the New Content Page, and it can also be accessed from the legacy Content Page by clicking **New Configurator**. [New configurator in the New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800842786713) [New configurator in the Legacy Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/57477784965785) [New Configurator UI] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800749573657) 1. **Object Browser** * View the list of objects used on the garment. Select an object to edit. 2. **Save/Add Colorway** * 'Save': edits made will be saved to the current selected Colorway. Only available for Configurator-created Colorways. * 'Add': edits made will be saved as a new Colorway 3. **Colorway List** * List of Colorways (from original file & created via CLO-SET Configurator) 4. **Tool Bar** * Switch between 'Select' and 'Edit Texture' tool * ![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305) Select object to be edited * ![Icon Pack \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776177664665) Edit Texture to zoom in/out or move the applied texture with a Gizmo tool. *Using the 'Edit Texture' will edit all 6 maps in Basic Parameters and Reflection. To edit each parameters separately, please use the Basic Parameters tab to input specific values. 5. **Property Editor** * Edit material property including Color, Basic Parameters, and Reflection. ***Please Note** : New Colorways created with New Configurator are **NOT** editable on the conventional [Configurator](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303180764313). ### 3) Color 1\. To start, select an object from your garment (![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305)) 2\. Click on 'Color' tab to start editing. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776185951257) 3\. Choose the color to be applied to the selected pattern **Picker** | **PANTONE** | **coloro** ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2024-07-02 at 5.16.01 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776186110489) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-02 at 10.53.05 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776209735193) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-02 at 10.53.20 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776209927705) * **Picker** : select the color to apply from the color picker, and click 'Find' below to find similar PANTONE color chips. Users may select from HEX/RGB/HSL options to input the color code. * **PANTONE** : select a color chip to be applied. Use the drop-down list for PANTONE palettes. * **coloro** : select a color chip to be applied. Search using the color name * **Custom** : select a color chip from your [custom palette](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303194294425) 4\. Use the '< (Back)' button to edit other material properties, or click 'Reset' to reset the properties. *Please note the the 'Reset' option will reset all properties including Color, Texture, and Reflection. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776186733721) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776210290969) ### [Color Switch] Color Switch prepares the solid fabric for a smooth transition to the newly selected color, ensuring it is applied accurately and seamlessly. * Learn about the Color Switch feature in [**CLO 2024.2**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Materials#01J8J0B16SJ6HJCMDVGKG9XNFB)![Switch Color.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776244377753) * **How To:** Open the [New Configurator](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303181526297), and select an object to start * From the right pane, click 'Base Color Map' tab * Below the Base Color Map, you will find the 'Color Switch' option * Please note that you can ONLY use either Desaturation or Color Switch, not both. When one is turned off, the other can be activated * Once the 'Color Switch' is turned on explore new colorways by changing the Color or Opacity * Color Switch and Desaturation can be used for all types of objects, except for button hole.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800746598041) ### 4) Basic Parameters 1\. To start, select an object from your garment (![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305)) 2\. Click on 'Basic Parameters' tab to start editing. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776185951257) 3\. Choose the maps to be applied to the selected pattern **Texture** | **Normal Map** | **Displacement Map** | **Opacity Map** ---|---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776211068953) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-03 at 5.20.11 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776227613209) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-03 at 5.20.32 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776188104985) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-03 at 5.20.46 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776211571353) * Basic Parameters works the same as in CLO's Property Editor. Learn more [**HERE**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Textures). * Select the parameter to edit * Upload, delete, or download a new map to be applied * Type in specific number fields to adjust the parameters in detail * *Opacity can be applied without the Opacity Map, and will be applied to the whole fabric. To apply opacity to selective parts of the fabric, please upload an opacity map. 4\. Use the '< (Back)' button to edit other material properties, or click 'Reset' to reset the properties. *Please note the the 'Reset' option will reset all properties including Color, Texture, and Reflection. ### [Auto-generate Normal Map] CLO-SET will auto-generate a Normal Map based on the Base Color Map for objects that have only the Base Color Map applied and no Normal Map available. * **Conditions** : Normal Map will be generated ONLY when the selected object meets ALL of below * has Base Color Map * does NOT have normal map * user adjusts Normal Map Intensity to a non-zero value ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776196960025) | ▶ | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776197087001) ---|---|--- * Deleting the base color map of the object will also delete the normal map.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776197384985) * The auto-generated normal maps will be deactivated when the Intensity is set back to 0.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776198025497) ### 5) Reflection 1\. To start, select an object from your garment (![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305)) 2\. Click on 'Reflection' tab to start editing ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776185951257) 3\. Adjust the Reflection. Reflection works the same as in CLO's Property Editor. Learn more [**HERE**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Textures). * Reflection has 2 properties - Roughness and Metalness * Roughness can be edited in 2 modes - Intensity & Roughness Map ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776214709657) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776246790169) * **Intensity** : Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness * **Roughness Map** : Edit fabric gloss by adding/modifying Roughness Map * Metalness can be applied without the Metalness Map, and will be applied to the whole fabric. To apply metalness to selective parts of the fabric, please upload a Metalness map. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776256678809) ### 6) Graphic Editor * **Select** : Click on the graphic directly, or select the graphic from the object browser. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800746607385) * **Edit** : Click and drag the Gizmo to adjust the Graphic: ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800749591193) * Triangle ▲ \- Uniform scale, adjust **width & length** in fixed ratio * Outer Circle ⦿ \- Rotate the angle of graphic * Inner Circle • \- Changes the position of graphic * **Change** : Select the graphic and click 'Basic Parameters' from the right pane. * Download: download the graphic file currently in use * Change: upload a new graphic to replace current graphic ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800749597977) * **Graphic Requirements** * Graphic properties must meet below requirements to use CLO-SET Graphic Editor: * Tile = None * Over Seamline = Off ![mceclip1 \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46262742103577). ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46262746458649) * If not met, Graphics will be marked ❌ from the object browser, and you can only adjust the Color of the graphic in CLO-SET. Please make changes on the .zprj/.zpac file from CLO3D software. ### 7) Save/Add Colorway ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776198953113) * When editing is complete, click _**'Add Colorway**_ ' to create a new Configurator-created Colorway. All new Colorways created in CLO-SET will have the purple water drop icon on the Thumbnail. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776247252377) * Users cannot overwrite the Colorways from original file. Edits made can only be saved as a new Colorway (with purple water drop icon). * Configurator-created Colorways (with purple water drop icon) can be edited/saved on CLO-SET. ***Please Note** : New Colorways created with New Configurator are **NOT** editable on the conventional [Configurator](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303180764313). ### 8) Troubleshooting * Compatibility: to use Configurator, please use a desktop or laptop. Any monitors with resolutions below 800 cannot use Configurator * Per the object type, there may be limitations to which parameters can be adjusted. Such restrictions will be disabled per the user's object selection. * For example, you can only edit the Color of Graphic. Basic Parameters and Reflection will be disabled.
content_description: Explore the comprehensive guide to using the New Configurator in CLO-SET, covering essential features, editing tools, and troubleshooting tips for optimal garment design.

title: Web Tech Pack ▶ Construction
content: #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732942489) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677355929) Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732944153) Editor ### # **Objective** ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732944921) | CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- The Construction tab displays auto-generated markers and allows construction annotation for all Content Types that have been pre-set in CLO3D. CLO-SET Construction is integrated with all the materials, trims, and even sewing methods of the 3D garment made in CLO3D. *** Construction is currently supported only in the Web Tech Pack of the legacy Content Page and will be added to the New Content Page in a future update.** * Data Sync from CLO3D BOM * Flexible modification, addition, and deletion of markers and their position * Easy-to-use annotation tools for texts and drawings * Availability of version updates as well as history tracking * Communicate with your partners, Share ideas, and Make final decisions for your outfits. ### 2\. How-To #### _Permission_ * * Admins: able to Edit and Delete others’ comments and annotations * Collaborators and Editors: able to Edit and Delete mine only ![construction_page_2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732945177) #### ![Screen_Shot_2022-08-17_at_10.54.09_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732945561)_Content Type Panel_ Add Pages for new Content Type 1. Click the ![AddPageIcon.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732946201)button. 2. Select a Content Type Reorder Pages 1. Drag and Drop the Page as you would like. 2. Cover cannot be reordered. Delete & Duplicate Click on the ![dotdotdot.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677358617) and Duplicate or Delete as you wish. ![leftpanel.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732946969) #### ![Screen_Shot_2022-08-17_at_10.53.49_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677359385)_Construction Viewer &![Screen_Shot_2022-08-17_at_10.54.56_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732947225)Construction/Comment Panel_ ![Screen_Shot_2022-08-01_at_5.09.25_PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677359897) To **Edit View Point** , click on the left icon to zoom in and zoom out and turn the camera with right click. * Rotation * Zoom In/Out * Camera Point * Keyboard Shortcuts To **Edit Drawing** , click on the right icon to make annotation drawings and add or delete markers. Please refer to the details of each feature from the left side of the Annotation Tool Bar. ![annotationToolBar.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732947737) * ![pic.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677360409) Attach Image \- After clicking on the viewer window, the File Directory will appear. * ![move.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732948889) Click \- You can move and adjust around other annotations that you have already created. * ![input_text.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732949273) Input Text * ![pen.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732949785) Pen * ![straightline.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732951065) Straight Line * ![curvedLine.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732951705) Curved Line * ![oneArrow.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732952473) One-sided Arrow * ![circle.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677363737) Circle * ![square.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732954265) Square * ![penColor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677364761) Toolpen Color * ![thickness.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677366169) Toolpen Thickness ![markerToolBar.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732955673) You can Add and Delete markers from the tool bar on the bottom of the 3D Viewer Window. ### ### **Examples** ![example2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677368089)![example1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677368473) ### 3\. Page Types 1. Cover Page ![cover.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677368857) * Viewer panel shows the ‘front’ and the ‘back’ images that are generated when saving the garment as Zpac and Zprj * Construction Version shows the list of history versions as well as the Current Version. * Page Name is named default as Cover, and it can be modified. 2. Pattern Page ![Pattern.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677369753) * Page Name is named default as Pattern, and it can be modified. * The markers of Pattern start from P1, using the ‘P’ prefix from Pattern. * The Pattern Panel displays the parts of the Patterns used for each Fabric from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Pattern list is identical to the order of the Pattern from CLO3D. * The construction markers of Pattern _**cannot be added or deleted.**_ * On the bottom right corner of the viewer window, there is a Pattern Layout, which can be clicked to view. 3. Fabric Page ![fabricPage.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677370393) * Page Name is named default as Fabric, and it can be modified. * The markers of Fabric start from F1, using the ‘F’ prefix from Fabric. * The Fabric Panel displays the names of the Fabric used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Fabric list is identical to the order of the Fabric from CLO3D. 4. Graphic Page * Page Name is named default as Graphic, and it can be modified. * The markers of Graphic start from G1, using the ‘G’ prefix from Graphic. * The Graphic Panel displays the names of the Graphic used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Graphic list is identical to the order of the Graphic from CLO3D. 5. Button Head Page * Page Name is named default as Button Head, and it can be modified. * The markers of Button Head start from B1, using the ‘B’ prefix from **B** utton Head. * The Button Head Panel displays the names of the Button Head used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Button Head list is identical to the order of the Button Head from CLO3D. * The count of Button Head is shown inside the parenthesis. ![buttonHead.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732957849) 6. Button Hole Page * Page Name is named default as Button Hole, and it can be modified. * The markers of Button Hole start from H1, using the ‘H’ prefix from Button **H** ole. * The Button Hole Panel displays the names of the Button Hole used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Button Hole list is identical to the order of the Button Hole from CLO3D. * The count of Button Hole is shown inside the parenthesis. ![buttonHole.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992677371417) 7. Zipper Page * Page Name is named default as Zipper, and it can be modified. * The markers of Zipper start from Z1, using the ‘Z’ prefix from Zipper. * The Zipper Panel displays the names of the Zipper used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Zipper list is identical to the order of the Zipper from CLO3D. * All parts of Zippers such as Zipper Puller, Zipper Slider, Zipper Teeth, Top Stopper, and Bottom Stopper, are shown in the Zipper Content Page. 8. Topstitch Page * Page Name is named default as Topstitch, and it can be modified. * The markers of Topstitch start from T1, using the ‘T’ prefix from Topstitch. * The Topstitch Panel displays the names of the Zipper used from CLO3D as shown in the Object Browser of CLO3D. * The order of the Zipper list is identical to the order of the Zipper from CLO3D. 9. Etc. Page * Page Name is named default as Etc., and it can be modified. * The markers of Etc. start from E1, using the ‘E’ prefix from Etc. * The Etc. Panel displays the names of the Etc. items used from CLO3D, such as trm. obj, fbx, dae, glb, and others. 10. Blank Page * Page Name is named default as New Page, and it can be modified. * Markers are not created in Blank Page. * This Page is for flexible usage of annotations. ### ### 4\. Construction Versions * Web Tech Pack is created for each individual content in CLO-SET. * Web Tech Pack data is based on the Version Updates. * The data shown in Construction is the data of the ‘Current’ Version’s zpac, or zprj file. * The versions that have been ‘Version Updated’ on WTP are shown in Construction. * For example, ContentA has 5 versions. And, Version 1, 3, 5 has only been Version Updated in WTP, then the Construction also only shows Version 1, 3, 5. * Editing can only be done in the ‘Current Version’. The past versions are View Only. **![construction_page.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992732959257)**

Once you create 2D POM, 3D POM will be auto-generated. > [• How to create POM](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025716774-Create-POM) > [• Edit POM](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025716814-Edit-POM-ver5-1-0-) > [• POM List](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025716854-POM-LIST) > [• Grading/Base Size](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000742668-Grading) ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 11.04.23 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778437318809) * Once you upload the .zprj / .zpac file, CLO-SET will import this data to WTP-Measurement. * You can add Target Measurement guidelines of Tolerance and HTM Comment and collaborate with partners to make the garment fit the designer's purposes and standards. ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 11.08.02 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778472589209) ### 2) 3D Viewer ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 11.14.27 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778488213913) | * View your garment in 3D on the left pane. * Select viewing option from the Tool Bar: * Turn Avatar on/off * Turn Garment on/off * Schematic Render * Background Color * Selected POM from the table will be highlighted on the 3D Viewer in red line ---|--- ### 3) Setting * Click on ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778488507417) icon on the top right corner to manage Measurement Preferences. ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 11.18.52 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778488741913) | * Select Measurement Type you want to view. Both the 2D/3D POM data is exported from your .zprj / .zpac file * Select Measurement Unit: Inch / cm / mm ---|--- ### 4) Version When you upload a new version of the Content, information on Measurement tab is also updated. To view the older Version, you may select from the drop-down menu. [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799507306265) [Legacy POM of WTP] ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 11.23.10 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778473826329) ### ### 5) Create Blank POM **1) When the content is blank** * In **WTP → Measurement** tab, a guide message appears: **“Create Draft POM.”**(Click POM tab in the new content page) ![Group 1005.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782607142169)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799525600025) * Click the button to generate a **blank Measurement Table**. [New Content Page]![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799525601433) [Legacy POM of WTP] ![Group 1009.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782579110681) * Column / Set Base / Delete Column**. * **Note:** For blank content, the **3D viewer is not available**. **2) When the content has no Measurement Data** * Click the button to generate a**Measurement Table**.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799525601433)![Group 1009.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782579110681) * Double-click each column to enter #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778373046681) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778388098457) Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778388301081) Editor # **Objective** ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778388458265) | CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- On the BOM tab, you can add/edit subsidiary materials and estimated cost critical for production. [New Content Page - BOM] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799149143065) [Legacy Content Page / WTP - BOM] ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 11.24.41 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778373826201) 1. Colorway/Grade/Version 2. Edit Material Detail 3. Add Material Item 4. Add/Delete Row 5. Version Update # **Details** ### 1)Colorway/Grade/Version ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 11.30.12 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778388740121) You may view the BOM data per Colorway, Grade, and Content Version * **Colorway** \- You may create new Colorway from CLO/MD software * **Grade** \- You may create new Grades in CLO3D software * **Version** \- When you upload a new version of the Content on CLO-SET, you can choose to update WTP information accordingly. * **[Important]** Information is managed and updated per **Colorway-Grade** combination, for all files uploaded from November 5th, 2024. For other files uploaded prior to this date, please re-upload. ### 2) Edit Material Detail ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 1.19.28 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374092313) * Non-Editable: Content ID (if uploaded on CLO-SET) / Name / Color / Texture / Marker are extracted from your zprj/zpac file. * Editable: Consumption / Unit Price / Total Price / Remark can be edited on WTP. This information will also be reflected on WTP - Cost Estimation tab * Material information may be added/edited/deleted per Colorway/Grading/Version per your selection. ### ### 3) Add Material Item ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 1.55.04 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374312601) **1\. Add Blank Row : Text-based Item** When you click on the **Add 1 blank row** , a new blank row is created. * * The **Name** can be edited. ![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 1.02.55 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263328857625) * * The **Color** can be picked. ![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 1.03.06 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263328860825) * * The **Texture** and **Marker** images can be uploaded. **![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 1.03.19 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263305690777)** **2\. Add Content Row : Item from CLO-SET** When you click on the **Add 1 content row** , a **Add Trim** pop-up is shown. You may browse through your Tree Menu or find Recent Trim files from your CLO-SET Group. ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 1.57.09 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374487705) * Contents added directly from CLO-SET will be marked with a blue 'CLO-SET' icon next to the 'Name' as shown below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374664089) * Please note that the Content Type must match the type of material you want to add. For example, to add a material under Fabric, the uploaded file must be in zfab format and identified as Fabric[ Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) in CLO-SET. * User must have 'Editor' or above [permission](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537) to the Workroom to which the original Content (to be added as Material) is saved. * When adding a material from CLO-SET, it will load the latest version that matches the file format. * Version updates on the Trim files will NOT be reflected to the WTP automatically. If needed, please delete the old material and add it again. * If the Trim file is deleted in CLO-SET, the BOM table will mark the material as 'deleted'. *Content Type can be selected upon upload. You can not change/edit the Type after the upload. **WTP Section / Subsection** | **Content Type** | **File Format** ---|---|--- Fabric | Fabric | zfab Trim / Graphic | Graphic | jpg, jpeg, gif, png, bmp, raw, psd, ai, tif, tiff, svg Trim / Button Head | Button Head | btn Trim / Button Hole | Button Hole | bth Trim / Zipper | Zipper | zpl, zpu, zsd, zsl, zst, zss, zsp Trim / Thread | Top Stitch / Thread | sst Trim / Top Stitch | Top Stitch / Thread | sst Trim / Others | Etc | trm ### 4) Add/Delete Row ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 2.01.55 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374843673) You may delete/add rows on the BOM table. Right-click on the Row to either delete it or add new above/below the selected row. ![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 12.58.44 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263328862361) To change the order of the rows, you may drag the No column cell and move around to adjust the ordering. _**💡 Notes**_ > _In order to view by colorway and grading in CLO-SETBOM, the content must have the corresponding data input from CLO3D colorway and POM._
> > _The name that will appear on BOM Colorway is the name you input in CLO._
> > _The Color chip that you see is the color chip of Fabric_
> > _If there are several fabrics, you will see the very first one on the top of the list._

# **Objective** ### Understand how to use the **AI Studio - Graphic Generator** on CLO-SET. 1. ##### What is AI STUIDO - Graphic Generator 2. ##### How to Use the Graphic Generator in CLO-SET # **Details** ### 1) What is AI Studio - Graphic Generator? AI Studio – Graphic Generator generates customizable graphic images from text-based prompts. By simply typing in keywords (or uploading image), you can create unique graphics that can be applied directly to your 3D garments and patterns. > **📝** Note : The AI Studio (Graphic Generator) is only supported on the legacy Content Page.
> > The AI Studio Graphic Generator feature is available only on paid plans.
> > The AI Studio for CLO-SET Enterprise is not yet available. (Not supported on separate servers.) #### **[Generate]** 1. You can choose either the **Text** or **Image** option in the AI Graphic Generator.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784829209) 2. Set options, enter prompts (or upload image), and click the Generate button.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946777066777) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784841113) **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Content Type** | Select the type of content. Generate embroidery graphics from simple keyword prompts, or instantly transform uploaded images into embroidery-style visuals. **Transparent Background** | Apply a transparent background to the image.**This option is not available for the Pop Art type.** **Text Prompt** | Enter the prompts. **✨ Writing Tips:** * **List the words.** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. * **Emphasize certain words more.** If parentheses are used in the word you want to emphasize, it takes up more weight.Parentheses on certain words take more weight. Weight increase rate : (word) 1.1 times, ((word)) 1.21 times. **![Frame 247.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784844825)** **Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI Graphic image is created newly each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as possible. It may differ from the existing results depending on the addition or change of the prompts. **Random** | The sample prompt is randomly applied. #### **[Apply]** 1. Click the Apply button below when the AI Texture is completely generated. → If you apply it, the result will be uploaded as a **new version**. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946777077785) ##### **📝Note:** It may take a while to create when there are many users at the same time. ### 2) Using the Graphic Generator in CLO-SET 1. AI Studio in Blank Content In the workroom, click the _**New**_ button and select _**Create Blank Content**_. After choosing a content type, click the _**Try Uploading from AI Studio**_ button on the blank content page to instantly generate image content using the Graphic Generator.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52948952725529)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52997568312601) 3. Version Upload with AI Studio _**Version upload**_ can also be performed using _**AI Studio Graphic Generator**_ when uploading a new version within the content page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52997568316697) ####

content: # **Objective** Learn about Content Information Fields in CLO-SET and how to effectively utilize the feature. 1. What is Content Information Field? 2. Default Fields** * Default Fields can NOT be added or deleted. You can change the name, values, and unit format. * CLO-SET Provides tailored Defaults Fields for each Content Type. * For example, for Style type Contents, there are 6 Default Fields - material composition, customer type, color, price, MOQ, and date. * To edit the name, value, or unit format, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. On the Edit modal, edit the details and click 'Save'. * ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778943746585) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778912589465) ---|--- #### **2\. Once the field is saved, field type **CANNOT** be changed. * Text (up to 100 characters) * Textbox (up to 1000 characters) * Number (in unit format) * Date (in calendar format) * Dropdown: single-selection * Checkbox: multi-selection allowed * To **edit** the Custom Field, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. [**Content Information Fields**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239598617) : Click 'More information' and add more information (material composition / customer type / color / Price / MOQ / Date). Render in CLO vs CLO-SET # **Details** ### 1) Render - How To * In the Content page, click the Render icon (![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808100314649)) on the left pane to start, and the Render Settings tab will open on the right pane. * Select the options as per needed, and **click 'Render'****** to create Render (_Learn more about_[ _Render Settings_](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207203225)) > _**Render on the Content Page**_

> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808100318105)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808100319257)
> > * Once you click **Render** , you may leave the page. When rendering is complete, a **render thumbnail** will appear in the **Viewer options list** on the **Content page**. > _**Render View on the Content Page**_
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808113701273)
> > * In **New** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56808100321049)
> > ### 2) Crop Option in Rendering Setting * crops to the nearest 5 pixels of the 3D content,_regardless of what is shown in the 3D Viewer_ * works both in transparent and colored background * Style Page > Render > Rendering Settings > Background > Crop * You must uncheck the 'Use Software settings' before applying the Crop option ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778676720025) In order to properly use the 'Crop' option, **the 3D content needs to be placed within the darkened frame shown inside the 3D Viewer.** Although the darkened frame does not reflect the cropped frame when the Crop option in clicked, _the 3D content is first cropped by the darkened frame_. Thus, if the 3D Content sits outside of the darkened frame, the render will be cropped. For example, if the render is triggered as shown below on the left, the result will be as the following on the right. ![Screenshot_2023-01-27_at_9.15.27_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778709349145) | ► | ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778724565657) ---|---|--- Final Render output shown below. ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778694043673) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778740992665) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778678578073) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778694926361) ### 3) Rendering Server Status 'CLO-SET Rendering Server Status' is a feature that allows users to be more aware of their rendering status with the information of server status and their current orders in the rendering queues. Find out more details on [THIS ARTICLE](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303263040921). ### 4) Render Preset For a unified Render output, you may upload a Render Preset for your Company members. Find out more [here](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129). ### 5) Render in CLO vs CLO-SET Basically, V-Ray's CPU and GPU rendering don't produce identical results. CLO and CLO-SET both use [Vray Rendering.](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115003861567-V-Ray-Render) However, CLO-SET only supports GPU rendering, whereas CLO supports both GPU and CPU rendering. The results of the GPU render of CLO and the render of CLO-SET are consistent. But, as CPU and GPU rendering results differ, you cannot expect to see the same results between the CLO CPU and CLO-SET GPU rendering results. We suggest the following workflow. Select the device before starting the rendering task and generate the final output. Choose either one of the workflow. > Utilizing GPU rendering in CLO and CLO-SET. > Utilizing CPU rendering in CLO. Unfortunately, attempting to synchronize the CPU and GPU is impossible. ### • Update in Render Settings (Feb 2024) The **default** **background setting** has been updated to match your Render Settings in CLO3D. You may choose to disable the option to customize the Render background in CLO-SET. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778722895257)

## **Objective** Troubleshooting error when requesting Render on CLO-SET or through API. Find the description of the error message, and learn how to solve the issue. 1. Troubleshooting Error 2. Checking Rendering & Server Status ## **Details** ### 1) Troubleshooting Render Error ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777955383833)
```
Error: Unexpected Error has occurred. Please check your file.
``` For this error message, considering checking below: * **Issue: Converting incomplete** * Please try again once the Content converting is complete. Render cannot be initiated while converting is in process. For newly uploaded files, this may take up to 3 minutes. If the converting failed, please contact us with the content page URL for support. * **Issue: Render size too big** * Width & height of the requested Render must be equal or less than 5000px. * **Issue: Invalid File Type** * Rendering is available for 3D files only. * Rendering is not supported for Blank Contents. Check [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) * **Issue: Missing mandatory information from the API request** * Preset ZVRP information missing. When uzeZVRP=true, then presetSeq field is mandatory. * Render Setting information is mandatory. Check the renderableScene field. * Invalid parameters. Requested Item Version cannot be set as 0. * Check Group information. The requested Group does not exist, or the user is not the member of the requested Group. * Check Render Preset. The requested presetSeq does not exist. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777930549273)
```
Error: Unexpected Error has occurred. Please report the issue HERE
``` For this error message, please [create a ticket](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new). Please include the Content Page URL for faster support. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777955725465)
```
Error: You have reached the allowed numbers of jobs that can be requested to Rendering queue.
``` For this error message, please wait until the requested Rendering is complete, to request a new task. Each CLO-SET Group can only request up to 100 Render tasks simultaneously. ### 2) Checking Rendering & Server Status * **Rendering Status** : While the Render is in process, you can view the status of your Render task. Click on the Render Thumbnail on the left of the Viewer to find the status, estimated time, and completion rate. Hover over the 'Render' icon above the Version list to view the Server status and the number of Render queues in your Group. [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56807491159449) [Legacy Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777946389785)
